evidence.api_compatibility: No API changes whatsoever. No exported symbols, no schema updates, no config format changes, no protocol changes. Not applicable.
evidence.documentation: This PR *is* the documentation update — it adds ai-content-policy.md, spec-driven-dev.md, updates contribute.md, PR/issue templates, AGENTS.md, the RFC discussion template, CONTRIBUTING.md stub, working-groups README, removes large-request-memory-benchmark.md, and wires everything into mkdocs.yml navigation. The commit touches only docs/, AGENTS.md, .github/ templates, and mkdocs.yml. Nothing user-visible in the release binary sense warrants a manual release test.
evidence.post_approval_commits: The first approval was from @ramkrishna2910 at 2026-09-08T17:24:03Z. evidence.security: No security-relevant code changes. The AI content policy adds a governance rule; the AGENTS.md canary is a trivial text string injection. No supply-chain changes, no network calls, no auth changes, no code execution paths. Not applicable.
evidence.tests: This is a documentation-only PR — no code, no tests, no weakening of existing tests. Not applicable.
